**Player 2**: **LAG/maniac, extreme calling station postflop AS PFA.** Opens very wide (~50% PFR). 4-bets and 3-bets extremely wide. **As PFA**: Calls down with virtually anything. C-bets most flops, checks dry/paired boards. Turn: AIR → checks/folds (float profitable); REAL HANDS → shoves aggressively. Folds to turn raises even after double-barreling. **Facing donk-leads: calls one street then folds to continued pressure.** **As 3-BET CALLER (OOP)**: Fit-or-fold — folds to c-bets when whiffing. Folds to check-raise all-ins and flop raises in 4-bet pots. **Exploit**: Flat opens IP with suited broadways/connectors. 3-bet QQ+/AKs only. Value bet extremely thin as PFA. Float flop c-bets. Two-barrel bluffs effective.

**Player 3**: **Selectively aggressive, skilled — most dangerous opponent.** Opens and 4-bets wider than premium. 3-bets from blinds vs ALL positions with wide range. Calls 3-bets with medium pairs. **Confirmed trapper — wide check-raise range** on wet boards in 3-bet pots. C-betting is SELECTIVE — checks back both dry boards AND wet boards without connections. Triple-barrels one-pair value with connections. Floating P3 is LOW EV — only continue with strong draws (9+ outs) or made hands. **Exploit**: Stab when P3 checks back (includes air on wet boards). Don't value-bet thin on river. Call 3-bets IP with strong suited hands.

**Player 4**: **Wide VPIP (~50%), passive preflop, MIXED postflop. HIGH VARIANCE.** Calls 3-bets with junk. Limp-reraise = strong. EXTREMELY sticky — calls river with bottom pair, 9-high. Check-raises turn with made hands. PASSIVE with strong hands — checks made straights through ALL streets. **3-bets are strong (JJ+/AQ+). 5-BET SHOVE includes JJ.** When P4 calls a 4-bet, range is NUTTED. As single-raiser: C-bets flop, folds to turn raises — FLOATABLE. **Exploit**: 3-bet for VALUE only. Value bet extremely wide (#1 value target). NEVER bluff. Respect check-raises/donk-bets/limp-reraises/3-bets.

**Player 5**: **Tight (~10-15% VPIP), stickier than typical nit with pocket pairs. ACCUMULATED CHIPS EFFECTIVELY — table chip leader trend.** Opens hands like A8s in position. Cold-calls 3-bets with medium pairs. Calls down with underpairs. Limps small/medium pairs. As PFA: C-bets flop then shuts down without connection. **Donk-bets CAN be strong OR weak — weak ones fold to raises/turn barrels; strong ones ESCALATE.** **KEY SIGNAL: ANY turn raise from P5 = monster (confirmed repeatedly).** **Exploit**: Two-barrel bluff donk-bets. Call flop c-bets wider — P5 gives up turn. FOLD to P5's turn raises always.

**Player 6**: **Station/spewy — wide limper and opener.** Limps with trash including small pairs. **As LIMPER postflop: EXTREMELY sticky — calls raises with bottom pair, semi-bluff raises do NOT fold P6.** Makes MASSIVE overbets for value. **4-bet shoves are NUTTED.** As PFA: C-bets flop then folds to turn donk-leads. Folds big pairs on ace-high boards. **Exploit**: Value bet extremely wide. Isolate limps for value. NEVER bluff. FOLD to 4-bet shoves. Respect massive overbets.

**Player 7**: **Wide opener AND wide blind defender, passive preflop, AGGRESSIVE postflop. SLOW-PLAYS PREMIUMS PREFLOP — cold-called 5-bet all-in with QQ.** Won't necessarily 3-bet premiums. Donk-leads and triple-barrels with strength. Raises flop with top pair on paired boards. Checks down passively with complete air. **Exploit**: Value-bet relentlessly, size up. Be cautious of cold-call/limp traps with premiums. Don't bluff.

**CRITICAL SESSION DEBRIEF (Session losing -$585, finished 7th):**
